headline: The AI Superintelligence Slowdown
summary: Tech leaders are now advocating for a slower approach to AI development. This shift follows concerns about rogue AI and warnings of existential risks. Major US AI companies are publicly pushing for increased safety measures.

headline: Claude Code relaunches Projects to manage multiple AI agents in the cloud
summary: Claude Code's revamped Projects feature enables managing multiple AI agents. Agents share memory, goals, and files within a single project. A "coordinator" directs parallel tasks via "threads" in each project.

headline: Save $30 or more on a refurbished Apple TV 4K
summary: Offset rising hardware costs by buying a refurbished Apple TV 4K. The 64GB model is available for $169, saving $30 off retail. This deal helps counter general price hikes on Apple devices.

headline: Xbox’s clever disc-to-digital feature was 15 years in the making
summary: Xbox's new disc-to-digital feature allows digitizing physical games. It comes as Sony discontinues PlayStation discs. This "new" feature actually has a 15-year development history.

headline: Far Cry TV Show Adds Oscar Nominee Jennifer Jason Leigh, Spider-Noir's Brendan Gleeson to Cast
summary: FX's Far Cry TV series adds five new cast members. Oscar nominees Jennifer Jason Leigh and Brendan Gleeson join. Other additions include Hamish Linklater, Sam Spruell, and Jamie Demetriou.

headline: Vin Diesel Mocked for ‘Architects of Mythology’ Post With George Lucas
summary: Vin Diesel's Instagram post with George Lucas drew mockery. He captioned the photo "Architects of mythology." The phrasing led to derision across social media platforms.

headline: The FlashForge AD5X Multi-Color 3D Printer Drops to Just $210 Shipped at AliExpress
summary: Get the FlashForge AD5X Multi-Color 3D Printer for $210. This significant discount is available on AliExpress. The same printer retails for $350 on Amazon.

headline: The WD Green SN3000 1TB PCIe 4.0 M.2 NVME Solid State Drive (SSD) Drops to $129 at Newegg
summary: The WD Green SN3000 1TB NVME SSD is on sale for $129. This PCIe 4.0 M.2 drive offers fast storage. It is PS5 compatible, though with certain considerations.

headline: Remains found after wildfire identified as mother-of-three missing since 2019
summary: Remains found after a wildfire identified as Joanne Sheen. Sheen, a mother-of-three, was missing since 2019. A 56-year-old man has been arrested in connection to her death.

headline: Charles 'sounded giddily elated' after Diana died, Earl Spencer claims
summary: Earl Spencer claims Charles was "giddily elated" after Diana's death. The explosive claim is made in a new book. Buckingham Palace has strongly denied the allegations.

headline: Father's tribute to 'sweetest little boy' Noah Woods
summary: Rhys Woods pays a heartfelt tribute to his three-year-old son, Noah. He describes Noah as the "sweetest little boy." The father expressed gratitude to the local community for their support.

headline: Watch: Can humpback whales experience grief?
summary: Rare footage suggests humpback whales may grieve their calves. Researchers captured the observations off Australia's Gold Coast. The video raises questions about animal emotions and loss.
